_comment: Kiro MCP config for the Governed Agentic Companion cloud front door via the LOCAL BRIDGE. Kiro spawns frontdoor/mcp_bridge.py as a stdio MCP server; the bridge signs in through the browser (PKCE, the public cognito_oauth_frontdoor_client_id client; no secret or password) on the first tool call, refreshes the token in memory, and forwards to the deployed AgentCore runtime. Copy the companion-engine entry into your workspace .kiro/settings/mcp.json (or ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json) and MERGE with any existing mcpServers. Set the absolute path to your clone and replace each <...> with the terraform output value (none is a secret; see docs/FRONT-DOORS.md) — never commit real ARNs or account ids. Governance is unchanged: the bridge only relays; the runtime's response is already gated in the cloud; a human deploys (Tenet 1). autoApprove is empty on purpose: each companion tool call returns proprietary knowledge into the IDE assistant's context. A team may add tool names here, knowing those calls then run without confirmation. Private mode (default): the gateway and runtime accept requests only through your VPC endpoints; from other networks the names still resolve and requests get HTTP 403. Connect over your VPN/Direct Connect path (with DNS forwarding to a Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint) or from an in-VPC desktop. Token sign-in to Cognito still uses public Cognito endpoints.
